name: Palo Brunch Warm Apple Cinnamon Sticky Bun (Cinnamon Roll with Maple Frosting)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Palo / Disney Treasure · Palo Steakhouse (Brunch)
whyItWorks: Baked fresh to order in a skillet: pillowy brioche cinnamon roll swirled with soft cooked cinnamon apples and warm maple butter frosting—100% citrus-free and a fan-favorite Palo Brunch highlight once the pecan garnish is held.
prepOrOrderInstructions: When ordering the Warm Apple Cinnamon Sticky Bun at Palo Brunch, ask your server to hold the caramelized pecan nuts on top (or brush them off completely) and take a Lactaid for the maple butter frosting.
watchOuts: Caramelized pecan nuts on top if not ordered without nuts
Rich maple butter frosting and sugar load
